paper.title_en: Wave Optics Effects from Gravitational Wave Propagation Through Dark Matter Halos
paper.abstract_en: Gravitational wave (GW) propagation is usually studied under the geometric optics approximation. However, when GWs propagate through structures of sizes similar to their wavelength, this approximation breaks down. To study this situation, we present a scheme for numerically evolving linearised plane GWs through stationary, spherical astrophysical structures in both weak and strong gravity regimes. Our simulations evolve the full Einstein equations (with all 10 components) for Gaussian, NFW and Burkert potentials. Our simulations show that the scattering of the GWs depends not only on the mass of the lens but also strongly on the gravitational potential distribution of the lens. Among our most important results, we find that the GWs do not propagate along null geodesics when propagating through the Gaussian density, neither in the strong nor weak gravity setting. Another significant finding is that in the strong gravity case of the Burkert potential, the convexity of the wave is flipped when leaving the structure. We compare our results with the linearized scalar wave predictions and find that the difference between these and the exact GW modes are of order one when the wave is inside the central potential. However, the difference reduces to only a few percent when the wave has passed through the structure. Although these effects are small, future GW detectors and Pulsar Timing Arrays (PTAs) could be sensitive to these signals which could thus potentially help in constraining the structure of dark matter spikes or halos.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文用完整爱因斯坦方程数值演化线性平面引力波穿过球对称暗物质晕（高斯、NFW、Burkert势），并讨论波长短于/接近结构尺度时几何光学失效的波光学效应，以及未来引力波探测器与脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）的可探测性；主题与PTA信号建模直接相关，理论深度和引力波传播的物理细节较丰富，值得点击阅读全文核验其数值方案与结论。
decision.title_zh: 引力波穿越暗物质晕传播的波动光学效应
decision.abstract_zh: 引力波（GW）的传播通常在几何光学近似下研究。然而，当引力波穿过与其波长尺度相近的结构时，这种近似会失效。为研究这一情形，我们提出了一种数值方案，用于在弱引力与强引力两种情形下演化线性化平面引力波穿过静态球对称天体物理结构的过程。我们的模拟对高斯、NFW与Burkert势演化完整的爱因斯坦方程（包含全部10个分量）。模拟结果表明，引力波的散射不仅依赖于透镜的质量，还强烈依赖于透镜的引力势分布。在我们最重要的结果中，我们发现在穿过高斯密度分布时，无论强引力还是弱引力情形，引力波都不沿零测地线传播。另一个重要发现是，在Burkert势的强引力情形下，波离开该结构时其凸性发生翻转。我们将结果与线性化标量波预言作比较，发现当波位于中心势内部时，二者与精确引力波模式之间的差异为量级一。然而，当波穿过该结构之后，差异缩小到仅百分之几。尽管这些效应很小，但未来的引力波探测器和脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）可能对这些信号敏感，因而它们有望帮助约束暗物质尖峰或晕的结构。
